label: New Project
help_text: Deliver a new solution, capability, or system that does not currently exist for the customer.

label: Enhancement
help_text: Modify an existing solution to change, extend, or correct its behavior.

label: Production Support
help_text: Address defects or issues in a live production system.

label: Maintenance Support
help_text: Sustain existing functionality without materially expanding it.

label: Enhancement Support
help_text: Reserve ongoing capacity for future improvements to an existing solution.

label: Implementation plus Support
help_text: Combine a delivery engagement with attached post-delivery support commitments.

label: Discovery or Assessment
help_text: Reduce uncertainty before a responsible full commitment can be made.
